title: Kieran original Wait immediately after Oscar Talk
steps: Close the previous Dolphin session. Launch ONLY work/fixtures/ch10_partner_actions_v1/Launch.ps1. It restores a byte-identical copy of the successful after-Talk state in a new private profile. Do not select Restart Chapter; loader setup must not be used for progression.

At the restored turn1 Yellow map, use Player2 map menu (E) > Options and set Auto End Off. Return to the map. Kieran should be Yellow next to Oscar inside the original cell; Oscar has already acted. Do not end the phase.

Use Player1 to attempt to select and issue an action to Kieran. It must not permit a command; cursor movement alone is not a failure. Use Player2 to select Kieran, confirm his CURRENT tile, and leave the normal action menu open. Save a new before.sav using Emulation > Save State > Save State to File.

Choose original Wait with Player2. Do not move, trade, attack, Talk, end phase or advance turns. Capture after.sav on the same turn1 Yellow map. If the phase auto-ends despite Auto End Off, save the resulting state and record the discrepancy instead of editing it.

Record the three observations in observations.json, capture both files with the supplied CLI and run review. Save a screenshot if a menu is missing or a command fails. This test cannot establish escape or permanent recruitment.
acceptance: Narrow automatic PASS requires both original UI observations and matching C11/live codes; Kieran force3/alive and only his acted bit changes, all roster identities/items/progression and Talk/door/chapter flags preserved.

title: Native Suspend and fresh boot after prisoner Talk
steps: Use a fresh disposable copy of the partner profile, not the successful Talk source. At the post-Talk map record Oscar/Kieran and capture before. Do not use the loader Restart Chapter route.

Use the original Map menu > Suspend. Capture the confirmation or exact original-card refusal as a screenshot. Save only in the new disposable profile. If refused, stop and record INCONCLUSIVE inherited-card identity; do not spoof it or overwrite another card.

If accepted, close Dolphin completely. Launch Dolphin with --user pointing to the SAME disposable User folder and --exec the original image, WITHOUT --save_state. Select the native resume route from the title.

Capture after at the resumed map before any actions. Verify same chapter/turn/phase, original consumed Talk key, living Oscar/Kieran, forces/control, acted states, progression/items. Preserve the private GCI and profile config after closing Dolphin.
acceptance: Separate original-card refusal from gameplay failure. Match equivalent checkpoints, not state-file hashes. No PASS for loading a savestate in place of a native save.

title: Kieran direct escape and carried-prisoner branches
steps: Do not attempt to traverse the weak inherited army or chain a new positioning patch onto the 3240-byte Talk fixture. A separately prepared, geometry-checked exit fixture or naturally progressed prison save is required.

Run separate branches from independent copies: (A) talked-to Kieran escapes through his original Escape menu; (B) an eligible actor carries Kieran through the original rescue/escape path. Capture before at the exit, after original escape dialogue, and cleanup after Ike exits LAST.

Record door-open history, conversation performed, rescued passenger identity, escape order and difficulty. Capture native dialogue and any missing Escape command. Preserve Oscar and every other surviving owned unit.

Save natively to a new disposable slot, fresh boot and capture reloaded at the next chapter roster. Test talked/not-talked and door-open/closed histories separately only when each can be reached through original events.
acceptance: Verify escape flags and prisoner retention through original cleanup; Talk alone is insufficient. Synthetic local escape may pass without certifying natural progression.

title: Carried unit escape, Ike-last and Chapter7 roster
steps: Start from a copied native Chapter6 save or a separately inspected exit fixture. Existing single-Oscar escape is already verified; do not repeat it as proof of the carried branch.
Use original Rescue to carry a living owned unit. Record carrier/passenger PIDs and factions. Capture before just before original Escape, then after the escape dialogue.
Escape remaining living units, Ike LAST. Capture cleanup, save in a new private slot and fresh boot into Chapter7 preparations; capture reloaded.
Repeat with Yellow carrier/Blue passenger and Blue carrier/Yellow passenger using independent copies. Record the original rescue eligibility if an intended pairing is disallowed; do not force it.
acceptance: Carrier/passenger identities, survival, progression/items and expected original cleanup persist. A synthetic exit skips natural traversal.

title: Yellow permanent death and Ike Game Over
steps: Create two independent disposable card/profile branches. Never continue the primary campaign from a death test.

Branch A: capture before with a Yellow permanent unit about to take a genuine fatal hit; allow original combat and death dialogue, capture after. Record the fatal attack and unit identity. Do not use a direct-death cheat.
Branch B: from a separate copy, let Ike die through original combat. Record original defeat/Game Over, capture its stable screen, and verify no inappropriate victory/next-chapter continuation.
For branch A, separately finish and reload the next chapter if reachable, checking the death remains and no duplicate/revived record appears.
acceptance: Separate Yellow death roster behavior from lord defeat. Normal death is expected; disappearing without a death record or progression continuing after lord defeat is a failure.

title: Yellow combat, healing, promotion and inventory
steps: Separate branches: Yellow attack/kill; enemy-phase counterattack; legal Blue-to-Yellow healing; Yellow healing if an owned healer exists; original promotion. Record actor/target and exact action. Do not change the fixed ownership table to manufacture a healer case.
Capture before and after each isolated action. Record displayed HP/EXP/level/stats, item durability, promotion choice and resulting class; capture the stat-gain panel as a screenshot.

Save and fresh reload for a promotion case and one inventory transaction, including a legal Blue/Yellow trade. Compare class, progression, items and expected durability changes; no duplicated/lost items.
acceptance: A different case folder/run per action prevents expected combat changes from hiding unrelated corruption. Missing healer/promotion fixture is NOT TESTED.

title: Two-PC original event, clear, native save and resume
steps: Use stable COOP-P6 + EXP-16, matching Dolphin/game revision and fingerprint on both computers. Boot through Netplay original native save workflow. Do not use synthetic save-state launchers; Netplay prohibits loading states.
Record host/client machine labels, Dolphin versions, game identity, configuration, port mapping, save-data sync policy and initial native card hashes. Keep originals untouched.

Both players execute an original recruitment/faction event and clear a chapter. Record host/client screenshots and Dolphin logs at matching stable checkpoints, including turns/forces/EXP and any desync/disconnect messages.

Have the host save to its disposable native card using the configured persistence policy. Stop both instances; start a NEW Netplay session from that native save. Compare both screens/rosters before input.

Do not load or require savestates in Netplay. If recording states is disabled, preserve paired screenshots/logs and native card hashes for manual review; this generic snapshot collector is then unavailable. Repeat after each confirmed compatibility-code change.
acceptance: Paired evidence and distinct machines are required. Local loopback alone does not verify two-PC behavior. No synthetic Talk/positioning configuration is accepted.
